description: Generate thought-leadership posts based on a news article. Omit articleId to auto-pick the most relevant recent article. Runs asynchronously — the user is notified when posts are ready.

articleId.description: Article id from list_news. Omit to auto-pick the most relevant one.

count.description: Number of posts to generate (default 1; only more when the user asks for more)

name: generate_from_news
title: Generate Posts From News
